episode_row: 3am cron chain's log redirect captured only the last command (pull/build/sync output dropped)

commits.subject: fix(cron): reorder 3am chain so preview survives sync-to-r2 failure
commits.body:
Previously: data pull -> build -> sync-to-r2 -> preview.
Now:        data pull -> build -> preview ; sync-to-r2

The preview pick is the user-facing morning deliverable; R2 sync is
nice-to-have backup. Putting preview ahead of sync (and decoupling
them with `;` instead of `&&`) means a Cloudflare/credential issue
in R2 cannot block tomorrow's preliminary pick from generating.

Also wraps the bts commands in a subshell so the log redirect
captures output from ALL of them, not just the final one — sh's
redirect operator binds to the last command in a chain, so the
prior layout was silently dropping pull/build/sync output.
